title: Environmental Action

passage.speaker: Friend
passage.text: Can you tell me about it?

passage.speaker: You
passage.text: Our neighborhood launched a recycling program last month.

passage.speaker: You
passage.text: Residents separate plastic, paper, and glass.

passage.speaker: You
passage.text: Although some people were skeptical at first, participation has increased steadily.
